name: Rorschach Bloom
desc: A bilaterally-symmetric inkblot that perpetually blooms and dissolves — fractal-noise ink spreads from the mirror axis into wet organic lobes and tendrils, pools dark at its bleeding edges, holds, then recedes as a new blot grows in deep indigo bleeding to oxblood on damp paper.

spread.doc: blot size / how far the ink reaches from the axis

density.doc: tendril richness & ink coverage (fractal detail amplitude)
